findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_local_businesses, get_business, start_request, get_price_list · Private data: search_local_businesses, list_categories, list_areas, start_request · Public sink: search_local_businesses, get_business, get_price_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_local_businesses, get_business, start_request, get_price_list · Private data: search_local_businesses, list_categories, list_areas, start_request · Public sink: search_local_businesses, get_business, get_price_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_business" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
